title: BlogPostUnpublishedPayload
description: blog.post.unpublished v1 (OpenVibe.Blog server/domain/publication.js afterChange, via openvibe-publishing/index-hooks publicationEvent). Emitted when a published post stopped being published, in the transaction of the change. For subscribers other than Search: canonical URL, publication state and Search-shaped indexability, never the body (Search gets that from blog.index_document.*). Envelope: subject { type: post, id: pst_…, revision: <published revision, 0 if none> }, visibility internal, priority important, actor the person or service:blog (scheduled and system changes).

canonical_url.description: null: the event carries a tombstone, which has no URL.

indexability.description: The last gate decision, or null when there is none.
